version: Local derivative of the official APS REVTeX apstemplate sample (header 4.2a), configured for PRX reprint and intended for REVTeX 4.2f
status: APS-sample-derived local drafting template; not an APS production template or proof of submission compliance
license: Official APS REVTeX sample template; retain APS copyright and REVTeX README restrictions. REVTeX class/styles are not bundled and must come from the user's TeX installation under LPPL 1.3c.
override_rule: An exact user-supplied venue, article type, template, or class option overrides this project default; a non-PRX selection leaves this profile inactive.

style.audience: A broad audience of physicists across pure, applied and interdisciplinary physics
style.narrative: Concise, self-contained account of an innovative result with clear long-term significance and context for non-specialists
style.structure: Content-driven sections that make the context, approach, central results, interpretation, and limits easy to find; no fixed section-name or section-count requirement
style.citation_rules: Use APS REVTeX bibliography style and provide complete article titles where possible
style.length_rules: PRX has no fixed four-page limit; keep the manuscript concise while providing enough context and technical support for broad readership

activation_rule: Use only when selected journal is PRX / Physical Review X, including the existing physics default resolved only when no venue is specified. Explicit PRE, PRB, PRL, PRX Quantum, other journal, or neutral format excludes this profile.
